EXIT=1
--- units left ---
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 1333 Oct 15 14:12 qisutu-daemon.service
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 1082 Oct 15 14:12 qisutu-install-complete.path

--- daemon ---
pid=

observation.command: systemctl start qisutu-install-complete.service; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "--- units left ---"; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo "--- daemon ---"; ps aux | grep qisutu-daemon | grep -v grep; pid=$(cat /run/qisutu/qisutu.pid 2>/dev/null); echo "pid=$pid"; [ -n "$pid" ] && kill -0 "$pid" && echo "DAEMON ALIVE"
